episodes.title: «Canbio» de planes
episodes.summary: A meeting with a client goes awry for Juan, a human rights lawyer, who finds himself embroiled in dirty prison politics after a riot traps him inside.

episodes.title: Condiciones más humanas
episodes.summary: As Juan tries to blend in, he learns the ins and outs of the prison's factions. While Gándara tries to regain control, Calancho holds Baldor hostage.

episodes.title: Falso Judas
episodes.summary: After Juan's secret is discovered, he faces a brutal initiation into prison life. In Ciudad Juárez, a precarious situation threatens civilian lives.

episodes.title: Uno de los nuestros
episodes.summary: Juan finds his freedom comes at a high price, while a bloody warning from 25 erupts Calancho's anger. Gov. Montes' citywide curfew impacts Helena.

episodes.title: Desechos humanos
episodes.summary: After seeing Helena, Juan spirals. Montes' extradition plan for Baldor moves forward with a new ally, as Gándara places a hit on Calancho.

episodes.title: Rey muerto, príncipe coronado
episodes.summary: As Gándara flees, Bautista infiltrates the prison, and Calancho makes a life-altering decision. Juan settles into a new kind of freedom.
